results.content: Nickel sulfate has several important uses in various industries: Electroplating: Nickel sulfate is a key component in electroplating processes. Battery Manufacturing: Nickel sulfate is utilized in the production of nickel-cadmium (NiCd) and nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) batteries.
